author: Vivid-Floor1145
body:
Ok, so most of what I'll say is reinforcing what others have said, but I think I can lay it out in steps you can take.

First is the weapon, you need better. I know you said the element is a problem for using the god weapons. This is true, but can be mitigated. Just pick your highest attack whether Thor's hammer or Vulcan sword doesn't matter, just need that attack stat. Get that leveled up with some nice crit+attack adornments.

Next, go into your skills. The T7 magistrate elemental strikes, (firestrike 3, icestrike 3 etc) are your friend. Go ahead and assign the one that aligns with your faction to your first skill. As long as your opponent doesn't have that resistance, that's your go to. It has a decent m1 and can crit. Additionally, it overrides the inherent element of your weapon. Add at least one other element as back  up for those resist cases, you'll lose the faction bonus but the m1 is still good. 

Next add Double Edge. That's a T5 battlemaster skill. If you don't have it, buy the class, it's cheap. That will also override weapon element but to physical rather than another element. It also has a decent m1 and provides an alternative in the face of multi element resist. It does cause self damage so you have to be tactical but it can be brutal.

Next, if you haven't already, complete the quest for your band of gods, and grind orns to buy Nyx. That'll give you the Elementless skill which will override the weapon element in general, making your elemental god weapon more broadly capable.

And last, grind more orns, buy your deity class and get that deity strike, it's the best melee m1 you're gonna have. 

Last fun tip, aside from live pvp, you get the first shot, don't waste it buffing and letting them buff, take the open shot and hit them hard.
